Framework Plan Implementation Committee Public Information Meeting

Framework Plan Implementation Committee Public Information Meeting

October 14, 2026

5:30 PM - 7:00 PM
SocialVenture, 5529 1st Ave S, Birmingham, AL, 35212
The City of Birmingham is inviting residents to get involved in shaping the future of their communities through the Framework Plan Implementation Committee, a community-driven effort designed to help guide priorities, track progress, and support improvements identified through Birmingham’s Framework Plans.
 
Residents are encouraged to attend one of two upcoming public information meetings to learn more about the committee, how it will work, and how they can participate.
 

Public Information Meetings

  • Thursday, October 8 | 5:30–7 p.m. 
    West Police Precinct Meeting Room, 2236 47th St., Ensley
  • Wednesday, October 14 | 5:30–7 p.m. 
    SocialVenture Meeting Room, 5529 1st Ave. S.
The meetings are open to every Birmingham resident. Residents are encouraged to bring their questions, ideas, and neighbors as the City works to ensure community voices help inform implementation of the Framework Plans.
 
The Framework Plan Implementation Committee will provide an opportunity for residents to learn about priorities, monitor progress, and help guide improvements in their communities.
 
For more information, contact the Birmingham Department of Planning, Engineering and Permits at (205) 254-2479 or bhampplanning@birminghamal.gov.
